benchmarks.name: Vending-Bench 2
benchmarks.metric: Frontier ending balance / $63,000 published good-strategy target
benchmarks.normalization: Cap at 100%; target is a published strategy anchor, not a human ceiling
benchmarks.notes: Year-long autonomous retail operation; balance is path dependent.

benchmarks.name: CEO-Bench
benchmarks.metric: Frontier best-run final cash / $2.2B estimated upper bound
benchmarks.normalization: Cap at 100%; only three runs per model, so treat as high variance
benchmarks.notes: 500-day startup simulation from $1M initial cash.

benchmarks.name: YC-Bench
benchmarks.metric: Frontier mean final funds / $1M published substantial-profit threshold
benchmarks.normalization: Cap at 100%; provisional target-normalized score because no human/oracle result is published
benchmarks.notes: The frontier exceeds the paper's 5×-capital threshold, so this score is saturated and needs a harder future anchor.

benchmarks.name: Business Arena
benchmarks.metric: Best-model mean final worth / $436,195 expert-strategy final worth
benchmarks.normalization: Cap at 100%; fixed expert strategy uses agent-visible information in the same world
benchmarks.notes: Ten-run model mean divided by the strongest published expert-designed strategy outcome.

benchmarks.name: EnterpriseArena
benchmarks.normalization: Already a 0–100% rate; use the best published full-survival result
benchmarks.notes: 132-month CFO simulator; only five seeds per system and the best published result is a tie.

benchmarks.name: RetailBench
benchmarks.metric: Best LLM final net worth / $131,510.42 oracle final net worth
benchmarks.normalization: Cap at 100%; privileged oracle is a ceiling-like reference, not a human-equivalent baseline
benchmarks.notes: Uses the v3 selected-run table; result is framework-selected and not a repeated-run mean.

benchmarks.name: MerchantBench
benchmarks.metric: Best LLM mean final net assets / human-participant mean
benchmarks.normalization: Use the authors' reported 27.3% human-relative ratio
benchmarks.notes: Three runs per model-framework pairing; human reference is three non-expert participants.

benchmarks.name: AutomationBench
benchmarks.normalization: Already a 0–100% pass rate; compare only within the public 600-task version
